title: H3b v4 fix round 1: routine_close runs gh outside bus.locked() and holds the lock only for bus updates; both call sites read [planner.routes].enabled with the same default (review T-0441)
spec:
STEP 0: the worktree must contain f2a1cf1 (T-0439, H3b v4) in git log; never drop or amend it.
Review T-0441 on T-0439, both findings to address:
1. (high) orchestrator/planner_runs.py:1301 routine_close calls _open_pr(goal) (two gh subprocess calls, 60 s timeout each) inside the with bus.locked() block opened at line 1283; a slow gh holds the cross-process bus lock for up to two minutes and stalls dispatch, gate, merge and any attached Planner session. Fix: take the lock only for the stamp (closed_at) and for each bus.update or bus.post_result; run every gh call and the retrospective record script outside the lock; re-read the goal under the lock before each effect so the evidence checks stay correct. Test: tests/test_planner_runs.py::test_routine_close_runs_gh_outside_bus_lock (patch the gh runner to assert bus.locked is not held while it runs, e.g. by trying a non-blocking lock acquisition inside the mock).
2. (low) orchestrator/daemon.py:176 auto_fix_round reads .get("routes", {}).get("enabled", False) while decision.route and the pool.toml comment treat a missing key as True. Fix: one helper routes_enabled(cfg) in decision.py (default True, matching the documented behaviour) used by daemon.auto_fix_round, planner_runs and decision.route. Test: tests/test_decision.py::test_routes_enabled_default_true_shared_by_callers.
Keep every T-0439 test green. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root until it exits 0, then git add -A and git commit with the task id; report sha and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows f2a1cf1 below your commit
tests/test_planner_runs.py::test_routine_close_runs_gh_outside_bus_lock passes and grep shows no gh call inside a with bus.locked() block in planner_runs.py
tests/test_decision.py::test_routes_enabled_default_true_shared_by_callers passes and grep shows daemon.py, planner_runs.py and decision.py all use routes_enabled
the nineteen T-0439 acceptance tests still pass
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
